user.title: Home Timer
user.description: One entry per area. Stations, presets and options are set up afterwards in the Home Timer panel – the cog of the area opens it.

data_description.area_id: Each area can be set up only once.

abort.already_configured: This area is already set up.

create_entry.default: Done. Set up its stations and presets in the [Home Timer panel]({panel}) – or later with the cog of the area.

start.name: Start
start.description: Starts a timer: on a station (target: its device or entities; replaces its timer) or in an area (target: the area or its Home Timer device), from a preset or with a name and a duration.

name.name: Name
name.description: What the timer is for, e.g. "Let dough rest". With a duration, instead of a preset.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long the timer runs. With a name, instead of a preset.

note.name: Note
note.description: Optional text that goes with the timer's events, e.g. for the notification. With a preset: instead of the preset's note.

source.name: Source
source.description: Optional data of the caller (a script, another integration); returned in every event of the timer.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: A preset of the targeted station, or a quick timer of the targeted area (its name). Instead of a name and a duration.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

add_time.name: Add time
add_time.description: Adds time to a timer. A ringing timer starts again with the added time.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

subtract_time.name: Subtract time
subtract_time.description: Takes time off a timer. Down to zero, it runs out.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How much time to take off.

cancel.name: Cancel
cancel.description: Cancels a timer, whatever its state.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge
acknowledge.description: Acknowledges a ringing timer, or all ringing timers of the targeted areas.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer's id (from the start action's response, an event or a sensor). Without it: the timers of the targeted stations.

assign.name: Assign to a station
assign.description: Attaches a timer to a station (target: its device or entities) of the same area. It keeps its state and time; a timer the station has is replaced.

timer_id.name: Timer ID
timer_id.description: The timer to attach, e.g. one started without a station.

invalid_duration.message: The duration must be longer than zero.

unknown_timer.message: There is no timer with the id {timer_id} (anymore).

ringing.message: The timer "{name}" is ringing; acknowledge it or add time.

one_area.message: The target must reach exactly one area set up in Home Timer.

timer_or_area.message: Give a timer id or choose an area.

no_area_in_target.message: The target does not reach any area set up in Home Timer.

invalid_source.message: The source must be data that can be stored as JSON.

one_station.message: The target must name exactly one station.

name_and_duration.message: Give a preset, or a name and a duration.

timer_or_station.message: Give a timer id or choose a station.

mixed_target.message: Target either stations or areas, not both.

preset_with_duration.message: A preset brings its own duration; leave the duration out.

other_area.message: The timer and the station belong to different areas.

todo_check_off_only.message: Ringing timers can only be checked off here; that acknowledges them.

unknown_quick_timer.message: The area {area} has no quick timer "{preset}".

open_timer.message: The timer "{name}" runs until its appliance is done; it cannot be paused or changed in time.

not_running.message: The appliance is not running – nothing to mark as done.
